content: {"praised":["DiCaprio delivers a compelling, realistic portrayal of Howard Hughes.","Stunning cinematography and beautiful visuals throughout the film.","Strong performances from the all-star cast.","Engaging story of Hughes' rise and fall.","Powerful depiction of Hughes' obsessive-compulsive disorder."],"criticized":["Film feels overly Hollywood-centric and lightweight.","Propagandistic tone makes it unwatchable.","Script is superficial with few good moments.","Lacks deep introspection into Hughes' character.","Pacing feels uneven and slow in parts."]}
